description:
Create many new listings in one call, one row each (category, title, price in VND, district, optional text, and photos where the category needs them), e.g. to move a stock list onto eno.

Rows are independent: a bad row fails alone, with its reason. When the account may not publish at all, nothing is created. A row repeating an active listing of this shop, or an earlier row of the call, fails as a duplicate.

Returns `created` and `failed` counts and `results`, one per row in the order sent: its `row` number, the new `id`, your `external_id` and the `error`, if any. To keep eno matched to your system by your own ids, use sync_catalogue.

listings.description: The new listings, one row each; every row succeeds or fails on its own

categorySlug.description: Category slug: vehicles, rentals, property, moving-sale, furniture-appliances, electronics, fashion-beauty, sports, baby-kids, books-stationery, hobbies-sports, pets, jobs, services, community-events, tickets-travel, food-drink (a job: jobs; a room or flat to let: rentals)

condition.description: The item's condition in words (cut at 60 characters), e.g. "new", "like new" or "used"; ignored for a job. Leave it out when it does not apply

description.description: The listing page's text: what it is, its state, what comes with it. No contact details (phone, e-mail, links); cut at 5,000 characters. Leave it out for no text

district.description: The district or area as free text, e.g. "Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức" (cut at 80 characters). A new listing needs it (else `location_required`)

externalId.description: Your own id for this listing, such as your SKU, echoed back in the results so you can match each row to your system; leave it out if you have none

images.description: Photos as public image URLs, in display order; eno copies them to its storage and uses the first 8. Most categories need 3 of different angles (else `photos_min`), services 1 (else `photo_required`), jobs none. On a new listing, leave it out only for a job

price.description: The asking price in Vietnamese đồng (VND); for a job, its monthly salary in VND

title.description: The headline buyers see: the item and what sets it apart, e.g. "Honda Vision 2022, 8,000 km". No phone number; cut at 140 characters

name: bulk_create_listings

results.description: One result per row, in the order sent

error.description: Why the row failed, in words to show the seller; fix that row and send it again on its own. null when it was created

external_id.description: Your own id for the row, echoed back; null when you sent none

id.description: The new listing's id; null when the row failed

row.description: The row's position in your list, from 1

title: Create listings in bulk
